source: EEX French Day-Ahead Base and Peak futures traded before the auction, collected locally; traded prices are not republished.
benchmark: the only benchmark of the level forecast: the window VWAP of the traded future, scored at the auction result
counts: windows (one per delivery day and product, base or peak) of settled delivery days whose published pre-market version of the default set (the version shown on the public site, read from published/forecasts.csv on main) was issued before the market window (11:15 Paris on the trade date), scored against the auction result; days whose published versions were all issued later, days with only a local version on the collecting machine, and days without a traded price are not counted; the backfilled walk-forward record in the README (42 windows) is a separate, out-of-sample reissue, not part of this count
